resources.string: He walks the floor, turns at the edge, and only sometimes climbs. A sit leads into a look or a rest, then he sets off again. Flick him and he flies. Pinch to resize. Tap to type. Double-tap to talk. Ask him to open an app, set a timer, or who texted you.

Alerts, texts, and contacts stay on this phone. He does not read other apps. A call opens the dialer so you still press call. Research only sends a question you ask, and only after you paste your own key.
Paste a Gemini key. It stays on this phone.
Research key saved on this phone.
No research key yet. He can still open a web search.
Tap the notification to open him. Stop removes him.
Ask, or say play a song
Yo Brian. I am moving on my own. Ask me anything.
